rows.name: [XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Can anyone explain what this thing is?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I believe it's one of the oldest creatures on Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I have only seen them as fossils[XENO:n ]
discovered around the capital.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]To find that they were trapped on Prison Island...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Was it protecting the island?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]That would imply it's sentient. I believe[XENO:n ]
it's responding to something primitive.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It doesn't care who or what we are.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Its instinct was to defend against anything.[XENO:n ]
But we'll never really know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We're losing time here. We still[XENO:n ]
